newsitem.title: GERMANY: German unemployment rises in September.
newsitem.headline: German unemployment rises in September.

text.p: Unemployment in Germany remained high in September, with the number of unemployed rising 39,000 to 3.991 million on a seasonally adjusted basis, the Federal Labour Office reported on Tuesday.
On an unadjusted basis, the number fell to 3.848 million from 3.902 million. The unemployment rate, based on unadjusted data, edged down to 10.1 percent from 10.2 percent.
"The improvement (in the unadjusted figures) was relatively weak due to too-low economic growth," labour office president Bernhard Jagoda said in a statement.
In west Germany, adjusted unemployment rose 34,000 to 2.748 million. The rate fell to 8.9 percent from 9.0 percent.
In east Germany, the number of unemployed rose 4,000 to 1.140 million, while the rate dropped to 14.7 percent from 15.0 percent.
